review_evidence: README identifies a deprecated SQLite3 binding for Lean; deprecation alone is not an exclusion reason.

SQLite/FFI.lean defines SQLite constants, raw connection/cursor types, public Cursor and Connection structures, opaque extern bindings, and connect/prepare wrappers; this is useful Lean interface prior art and is retained.

Tests/SQLite.lean exercises the retained public interface and demonstrates parameter binding/query/result APIs; SQLite.lean is the import root. Main.lean is a standalone demo and lakefile.lean native build orchestration.

rules.content_invariant: The file owns only trivial helper/demo functions and an IO main that opens a test database and exercises the retained SQLite.FFI interface; public binding structures and extern declarations remain indexed.
evidence: Complete Main.lean inspected; it imports SQLite and runs example queries/printing.
rules.rationale: This exact executable is a SQLite usage demo/runner rather than the binding interface itself.

rules.content_invariant: All declarations select the C compiler or define Lake object/static-library/executable targets; no SQLite formal interface declaration exists only in this file.
evidence: Complete lakefile.lean inspected: sqlite.o/sqliteffi.o/libsqlite targets, executable/test driver, and LSpec dependency.
rules.rationale: This exact Lake file is native C compilation/linking and package/test-target configuration for the retained SQLite binding.

summary: Reviewed sqlite-lean; the public Lean SQLite FFI structures/extern interface and usage tests remain searchable, while exact demo/build entrypoints are excluded.
